title: fix(cli): two builds of an unchanged app ship one legacy runtime module, so its hashed name and runtimeModule ref stop changing
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X7csHsNjL2aQgnCaNu1p3hu)_

Fixes #26478

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** `os build` 打包旧版运行时模块时，临时入口不再以「进程号+时间戳」命名写到配置旁边，而是以固定名经 esbuild stdin 传入；模块里的路径一律相对配置所在目录。
- **为什么改:** 同一个应用每次重建都会产出新的 `objectstack-runtime.HASH.mjs` 文件名和新的 `runtimeModule` 引用，缓存与部署 diff 永远不收敛（#7651 当年缺的复现就是这个）。
- **风险与回滚:** 风险低，只改一个函数的 esbuild 入参，模块导出与行为不变；回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `packages/cli/src/utils/build-runtime.ts`（`buildRuntimeBundle` 里 `esbuild.build` 的 `stdin` 与 `absWorkingDir` 两处）；`packages/cli/test/build-runtime-reproducible.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit test/build-runtime-reproducible.test.ts`，预期 3 个用例全绿；在 main 上同一命令红 2 个（文件名不同、sourcemap 带临时目录与进程号）。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

`buildRuntimeBundle` (`packages/cli/src/utils/build-runtime.ts`) used to write its generated esbuild entry beside the config as `.objectstack-runtime.entry.PID.TIMESTAMP.mjs`. esbuild prints every input's path into the output, once as a path comment above that input's code and once in the inline sourcemap's `sources`, and the module's file name is `sha256` over that output. So `process.pid` and `Date.now()` reached the shipped bytes and the name, and no two builds could share a name.

Now:

- The entry is handed to esbuild as `stdin` (`contents` = the same generated source, `resolveDir` = the config's directory, `sourcefile` = the fixed `.objectstack-runtime.entry.mjs`). Nothing is written next to the config, so concurrent builds share no file, and the `unlinkSync` cleanup paths are gone.
- `absWorkingDir` is the config's directory. The audit the order asked for (any other per-run value reaching the bundle) found one more of the same mechanism: every path esbuild prints was relative to the process cwd, so the same app built from another directory (`os build path/to/objectstack.config.ts`) or another checkout location shipped different bytes and a different name. Paths are now relative to the config, so they read `objectstack.config.ts`, `slug.ts`, `.objectstack-runtime.entry.mjs`.

Nothing else per-run reaches the module. Read on a real bundle: the banner is a constant; `meta.builtAt` is emitted as the source text `new Date().toISOString()`, evaluated when the module is imported, not a build-time value; `LOCATORS` and `refCount` derive from the config; `sourcesContent` carries file contents only; packages are external, so no `node_modules` path is printed.

The suggested route's example (a fixed name inside a per-build temp directory) was not taken: a `mkdtemp` directory name is itself random and esbuild would print it into the same comment and sourcemap, so the bytes would still differ. `stdin` gives a stable name with no directory at all.

## Why

Two builds of an unchanged app must give a byte-identical bundle, the same file name and the same `runtimeModule` ref in `dist/objectstack.json` (triage ruling on #26478). Otherwise any cache or CDN keyed on the name is busted every build and every deploy diff shows the artifact as changed.

## Tests

New `packages/cli/test/build-runtime-reproducible.test.ts`, `unit` tier: it calls `buildRuntimeBundle` in-process (no CLI spawn) on a fixture whose hook calls a helper imported from another module, so the handler is bundled.

1. Two builds into one `dist/` give the same `outputFileName`, the same `hash`, byte-identical files, and only one file in `dist/`.
2. The inline sourcemap's `sources` are exactly the three config-relative names, and the module text does not contain the fixture's `mkdtemp` directory name.
3. Nothing is left beside the config, and the module imported back serves the hook and runs it (`'  Hello World '` becomes `'hello world'`), which shows the `stdin` entry still resolves the config and its transitive import.

Red first on the base (`c7d6ca8e`, test committed alone as `c1c07c89`): cases 1 and 2 fail, case 3 passes.

<details><summary>Red on the base, green on the fix, and the ablation</summary>

Base, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 test/build-runtime-reproducible.test.ts` under the verify lock:

```text
× two builds of an unchanged app give byte-identical modules under one name
AssertionError: expected 'objectstack-runtime.0d8a62ba362af40a.…' to be 'objectstack-runtime.0509e52d02fdce77.…'
× the module names its inputs relative to the config, never a per-run or machine-local path
+   "../../../../../tmp/os-build-runtime-reproducible-fADw6M/app/.objectstack-runtime.entry.1505.1793084124288.mjs",
+   "../../../../../tmp/os-build-runtime-reproducible-fADw6M/app/objectstack.config.ts",
+   "../../../../../tmp/os-build-runtime-reproducible-fADw6M/app/slug.ts",
Tests  2 failed | 1 passed (3)
os-verify-lock: VERDICT command-exit 1
```

Fix (`37a263c1`): `Tests  3 passed (3)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.

Ablation of the `absWorkingDir` line through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `36fb893d` → `d6c7a478`): case 2 red with the cwd-relative `sources` above (now with the fixed entry name), cases 1 and 3 green; restored to blob `36fb893d` = HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. The test imports `../src/`, so no `dist/` rebuild sits between the edit and the run.

Outside the test, the same app built from two different cwds through `tsx` produced `objectstack-runtime.29956dd5d3b128f6.mjs` both times.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The test is in-process, so it does not spawn `os build` at all; `compile.ts` hands `outputFileName` to `runtimeModule` unchanged (`finalBundle.runtimeModule = ./FILE`), so the artifact ref follows the name.
- Open PRs on this file: a search of open PRs for `build-runtime` returned 13 hits, none of which is a CLI build change.

## Verification

All local readings at head `c914e2e6`.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2` (whole `unit` tier): 336 files passed, 2 failed only because `packages/cli` itself was not yet built (`packages/cli is not built (./dist/index.js is absent)`). After `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build`, those two (`published-subpath-console.pin`, `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`) pass: 29/29.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit && pnpm check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the two touched source files: exit 0.
- The `integration` tier is declared to CI: the diff touches no spawn entry and no integration-tier file.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 61 families; 60 ran green, and `--ran` reconciles `61 derived, 60 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

<details><summary>Gate readings</summary>

- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`: NOT MEASURED, exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it reads every package's `dist/`, and only the CLI's closure was built). CI's Lint and Repo Gates runs it.
- Four gates first exited 3 because they ran before the CLI build or on a shallow clone, then went green on a re-run after `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli build` and `git fetch --unshallow`: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-coverage`, `check:i18n-walk-parity`.
- Every other derived family: exit 0.

</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No `packages/spec` change.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint on the touched files).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset (`@objectstack/cli` patch).
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
